[EN] One Step Forward
[ES] Un paso adelante
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Madat to discuss the next step.
[ES] Habla con Madat para discutir el siguiente paso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I will. Thank you!"
[ES] "Lo haré. ¡Gracias!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Kazan's Ridge in the north to find Durom.
[ES] Ve a Kazan's Ridge en el norte para encontrar a Durom.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Well, it was worth a shot."
[ES] "Bueno, valía la pena intentarlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Karlam.
[ES] Habla con Karlam.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sounds like a plan."
[ES] "Me parece un buen plan."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to High Seeker Janiam.
[ES] Habla con el Gran buscador Janiam.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Valley Grizzlies and Valley Mugatos on Kazan's Ridge.
[ES] Mata osos pardos del valle y mugatos del valle en Kazan's Ridge.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks—and good luck here."
[ES] "Gracias y buena suerte por aquí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Seeker Tercad where to find High Seeker Janiam.
[ES] Pregúntale al buscador Tercad dónde encontrar al Gran buscador Janiam.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
